name: GitHub Issue Triaging
purpose: Classify incoming issues, detect duplicates, assign milestones, and link to roadmap Goals.
inputs: Untriaged issue batch with sanitized reports
Repository labels, CODEOWNERS, component map, and SLA
Roadmap milestones, duplicate history, and disclosure policy
outputs: Triage decision for every issue in the batch
Reproduction, duplicate, security, label, owner, and milestone actions
stop_conditions: Every issue has a qualification, security decision, owner route, milestone state, and reporter update
